title: User-type axis (install filter)
$comment: Source: user-types/README.md § Schema. One file per user-type under user-types/<id>.yml. `id` MUST equal the filename stem. Owning roadmap: agents/roadmaps/step-9-user-types-axis.md.

id.description: Stable slug. MUST equal the filename stem and the value used in skills' `recommended_for_user_types` frontmatter.

description.description: One-line audience description shown in install.sh --help and the user-types/README.md index.

primary_workflows.description: Snake-case verb-phrases describing what this user-type does most days. Informs which skills surface first.

default_skill_priority.description: Hand-curated short-list of 3–6 skill stems that should auto-load on `install.sh --user-type=<id>`.

notes.description: Optional one-line caveat (overlap with sibling user-types, legacy semantics, etc.).
